geometryInvalidBecause: The wrist end of the palm is outside the frame — the HUD on this screenshot reads "Poora haath frame mein laao". MEASURED on a synthetic hand pushed out by the same amount: once the wrist crosses the frame edge, canonical zone positions move by 4-15 video px at first contact and up to 54 px when the hand is a third of a frame out, because MediaPipe extrapolates the landmarks it cannot see and the homography is then fitted to guesses. Canonical-space ground truth cannot be recorded: the canonical space itself is displaced by more than a crease is wide, so "where the heart line should be in crop coordinates" has no stable answer.
